result.summary: This is a dense urban commercial environment featuring wide sidewalks and marked continental crosswalks. While basic pedestrian infrastructure is present, the multi-lane roadway and wide turning radii create exposure risks for people crossing.

hazards.name: Wide Turning Radius
hazards.description: The corner geometry allows for relatively high-speed vehicle turns, increasing risk to pedestrians in the crosswalk.

hazards.name: Multi-lane Crossing Exposure
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a median refuge, increasing exposure time to vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the image across the roadway

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and slow turning vehicles by tightening the corner radius.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program traffic signals to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicles get a green light, increasing visibility.

interventions.title: Raised Crosswalk
interventions.description: Elevate the crosswalk to the level of the sidewalk to act as a speed table and increase pedestrian visibility.

result.summary: The image shows a dense urban commercial street with wide, well-maintained sidewalks and curb ramps. However, the intersection lacks marked crosswalks, and intense sun glare significantly reduces visibility for all road users.

hazards.name: Sun Glare
hazards.description: Intense direct sunlight creates significant glare, potentially blinding drivers and making pedestrians difficult to see.
hazards.location_in_image: Center and upper portion of the roadway view

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: Lack of painted crosswalk markings at an intersection with curb ramps may lead to driver failure to yield.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install zebra-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian space and improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles get a green light, increasing visibility.

result.summary: The image shows a busy urban intersection with significant pedestrian activity but a lack of basic crossing infrastructure. While sidewalks are wide and in good condition, there are no marked crosswalks or curb ramps visible at the immediate crossing point.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crosswalk
hazards.description: There are no painted markings to indicate a pedestrian crossing area, which can lead to driver confusion and reduced safety.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground where pedestrians are crossing.

hazards.name: Lack of Curb Ramps
hazards.description: The absence of sloped curb transitions makes the crossing inaccessible for people with mobility devices or strollers and creates a trip hazard.
hazards.location_in_image: At the corner where pedestrians are stepping into the street.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style crosswalk markings to clearly define the pedestrian path.

interventions.title: Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install ADA-compliant curb ramps with tactile warning strips at all crossing points.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions (bulb-outs) to reduce the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The image shows a dense urban commercial environment with wide sidewalks and a signalized intersection. While basic pedestrian infrastructure like signals and marked crossings are present, the crossing distance is moderate and sightlines are partially obscured by vehicles near the corners.

hazards.name: Vehicle Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: A silver SUV is stopped or parked very close to the intersection, which can block the view of pedestrians for oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the intersection near the crosswalk area

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The painted crosswalk markings are somewhat worn, reducing their visibility to drivers.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder style crosswalk markings to increase visibility.
